    else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } set_variable = cmp_regions2_state_blocked }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { state_has_building_type_levels = { target = bt:$BUILDING$ value = 999 } }
    create_building = { building = $BUILDING$ level = 1000 }
    if = { limit = { state_has_building_type_levels = { target = bt:$BUILDING$ value = 1000 } } root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success } }
    else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } set_variable = cmp_regions2_state_blocked }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = { state_has_building_type_levels = { target = bt:$BUILDING$ value = 1000 } }
    create_building = { building = $BUILDING$ level = 1001 }
    if = { limit = { state_has_building_type_levels = { target = bt:$BUILDING$ value = 1001 } } root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success } }
    else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } set_variable = cmp_regions2_state_blocked }
  }
  else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_overflow } set_variable = cmp_regions2_state_blocked }
}

cmp_regions2_build_add_one_guarded_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      NOT = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_state_blocked }
      OR = {
        AND = { NOT = { has_building = $BUILDING$ } can_construct_building = $BUILDING$ }
        any_scope_building = { is_building_type = $BUILDING$ can_queue_building_levels = 1 }
      }
    }
    cmp_regions2_build_add_one_exact_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_state_blocked } } set_variable = cmp_regions2_state_blocked root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_blocked } }
}

cmp_regions2_apply_building_type_effect = {
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 1 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 1 } cmp_regions2_build_add_1_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 1 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 2 } cmp_regions2_build_add_5_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 1 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 3 } cmp_regions2_build_add_10_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 1 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 4 } cmp_regions2_build_add_25_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 1 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 5 } cmp_regions2_build_add_50_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 1 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 6 } cmp_regions2_build_add_100_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 2 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 1 } cmp_regions2_build_set_1_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 2 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 2 } cmp_regions2_build_set_5_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 2 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 3 } cmp_regions2_build_set_10_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 2 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 4 } cmp_regions2_build_set_25_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 2 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 5 } cmp_regions2_build_set_50_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 2 root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 6 } cmp_regions2_build_set_100_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ } }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 3 } remove_building = $BUILDING$ if = { limit = { state_has_building_type_levels = { target = bt:$BUILDING$ value = 0 } } root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success } } else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } } }
}

cmp_regions2_resource_traits_clear_water_effect = {
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_scarce } remove_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_scarce } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_normal } remove_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_normal } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_humid } remove_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_humid } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_very_humid } remove_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_very_humid } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_hydroelectric_water_deposits } remove_state_trait = state_trait_hydroelectric_water_deposits } }
}
cmp_regions2_resource_traits_set_water_effect = {
  cmp_regions2_resource_traits_clear_water_effect = yes
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 3 } state_region = { add_state_trait = state_trait_groundwater_normal } }
}

cmp_regions2_resource_traits_clear_bauxite_effect = {
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_nano_bauxite_mine } remove_state_trait = state_trait_nano_bauxite_mine } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_small_bauxite_mine } remove_state_trait = state_trait_small_bauxite_mine } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_medium_bauxite_mine } remove_state_trait = state_trait_medium_bauxite_mine } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_big_bauxite_mine } remove_state_trait = state_trait_big_bauxite_mine } }
  state_region = { if = { limit = { has_state_trait = state_trait_huge_bauxite_mine } remove_state_trait = state_trait_huge_bauxite_mine } }
}

cmp_regions2_apply_resource_type_effect = {
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_potential_resource = $BUILDING$ } } state_region = { add_resource_potential = $BUILDING$ }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 2 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 4 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 3 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 9 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 4 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 24 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 5 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 49 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 6 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 99 } } }
    }
    else = {
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 1 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 1 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 2 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 5 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 3 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 10 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 4 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 25 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 5 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 50 } } }
      if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 6 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 100 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_potential_resource = $BUILDING$ } root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success } } else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } }
  }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 2 } if = { limit = { has_potential_resource = $BUILDING$ } state_region = { remove_resource_potential = $BUILDING$ } } state_region = { add_resource_potential = $BUILDING$ }
    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 2 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 4 } } }
    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 3 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 9 } } }
    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 4 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 24 } } }
    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 5 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 49 } } }
    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_amount_index = 6 } state_region = { change_resource_potential = { type = $BUILDING$ amount = 99 } } }
    if = { limit = { has_potential_resource = $BUILDING$ } root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success } } else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } }
  }
  if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_regions2_operation_index = 3 } if = { limit = { has_potential_resource = $BUILDING$ } state_region = { remove_resource_potential = $BUILDING$ } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_potential_resource = $BUILDING$ } } root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success } } else = { root = { set_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } } }
}

cmp_regions2_finish_result_effect = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success OR = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_overflow has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_blocked has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_unsafe } } set_variable = { name = cmp_regions2_result value = 3 } }
  else_if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success } set_variable = { name = cmp_regions2_result value = 1 } }
  else_if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_unsafe } set_variable = { name = cmp_regions2_result value = 7 } }
  else_if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_blocked } set_variable = { name = cmp_regions2_result value = 6 } }
  else_if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_overflow } set_variable = { name = cmp_regions2_result value = 4 } }
  else_if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed } set_variable = { name = cmp_regions2_result value = 5 } }
  else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_regions2_result value = 2 } }
  remove_variable = cmp_regions2_any_success remove_variable = cmp_regions2_any_failed remove_variable = cmp_regions2_any_overflow remove_variable = cmp_regions2_any_blocked remove_variable = cmp_regions2_any_unsafe
}
